subject: Invoice routing, E-file Tax ID & split billing for Q4 expansion
messages:
From: Elena Martinez <elena@cloudscale.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.com>, procurement@cloudscale.com
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 10 Sep 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice routing, PO attached — Q4 expansion

Hi Rachel / Redwood team,

Thanks again — CloudScale is planning to expand our Dedicated capacity commitment for Q4 (added 8 GPU nodes, see attached PO). Procurement asked me to confirm a few billing items so our vendor onboarding can complete:

- Can invoices be split between CloudScale LLC (US ops) and CloudScale EMEA for tax purposes? We usually have two separate billing contacts and want two invoices per month.
- We need Redwood to accept Net30 payment terms for the expansion (previously Net45). Is that possible?
- Please confirm Redwood's tax ID for our E-file system — our AP team requires a PDF W9 (if US entity) or equivalent tax form.
- Attached is the signed PO (PO_CloudScale_Q4_2028.pdf).

Can you confirm next steps and timeline so procurement can open the vendor ticket? We prefer invoices to go to:
 - us-invoices@cloudscale.com (CloudScale LLC, remit-to)
 - eu-invoices@cloudscale.com (CloudScale EMEA)

Appreciate a quick turnaround — procurement is looking to close the order by end of week.

Thanks,
Elena Martinez
Head of FinOps, CloudScale Inc.
From: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@cloudscale.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Sep 2028 16:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice routing, PO attached — Q4 expansion

Elena — thanks for the PO and the clear list. Quick answers and next steps: 

- Split invoices: yes, we can produce two invoices per month and route them to the two addresses you listed. Please confirm the billing legal names and remit addresses for both entities and we’ll mirror that on our invoices.
- Net30: I’ve flagged this to finance for approval (see Marcus on CC). We typically default to Net45 but are open to Net30 for committed capacity expansions — final approval needed.
- Tax form: attaching our W9 (W9_Redwood_Inference.pdf) for your E-file intake. If procurement needs any other tax docs for our Delaware entity let me know.
- PO: received. We’ll attach your PO number to invoices and to the internal order.

Next steps: 
 1) Marcus — can you confirm finance approval for Net30 on DEAL-7892? If approved we’ll update the SOW and billing cadence.
 2) Elena — please confirm the exact legal names for US and EMEA billing and preferred billing contacts (name + email + remit address).

We can turn this around once finance signs off — aiming to have PO and billing set up by Wed 9/12.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415 555 0192

Rachel / Marissa — I reviewed the PO and the customer history. Approve Net30 for DEAL-7892 under these conditions: 

- Customer provides W9 (received) and confirms two legal entities for split invoicing.
- Finance retains right to revert to Net45 if late payments occur twice in a 6-month window.
- We set up two invoice recipients, but a single contract will cover both billing entities (remit-to split only).

I’ll update the billing terms in the order system and notify AR. Rachel, loop me into any DocuSign amendment so I can attach internal approval.

Marcus Lin
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference

- Net terms: Net30 (approved) — will appear on the first invoice after provisioning.
- Split invoices: we will produce two invoices per month and route them to us-invoices@cloudscale.com and eu-invoices@cloudscale.com. Please confirm the legal names and remit addresses you want printed on each invoice.

Once you confirm the remit names/addresses we’ll complete vendor setup and send the first invoice. If procurement needs an AR contact, please use: ar@redwood.com with subject line "Remit: CloudScale / DEAL-7892".

Thanks — looking forward to getting you scaled up.

Best,
